narr: Scattered thunderstorms near a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of south central and southeast Virginia.
ev: Street flooding was reported at London Boulevard and Effingham Street.
Street flooding was reported. Street was closed. Vehicles were stranded.
Southbound lanes were closed on Route 642 at Mile Marker 6 in Amelia county due to flooding.
Car was partially submerged in about two feet of water at the intersection of Independence Boulevard and Columbus Street. Individual was able to leave vehicle to safety on their own.
Route 633 was closed in Brunswick County in the vicinity of Smoky Ordinary Road due to high water.
Flash flooding was reported in Norfolk at the junction of Boush Street and Olney Road.
Standing water was reported on Claremont Street near Williamsburg.
Several roads in Newport News were impassable due to flash flooding.
Warwick Boulevard was impassable between 42nd Street and 49th Street.
Numerous roads in the vicinity of the Newport News shipyard were closed or impassable due to high water.
Street flooding was reported at the intersection of Virginia Beach Boulevard and West Rosemont Road.
